# `aitbc market offer-cancel`

Cancel one or more hardware and software bundle offers by order IDs.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market offer-cancel [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--order-ids` | text (multiple) | — | yes | On-chain listing id to cancel (the listing_id field of /rpc/market/listings, e.g. tx_297); repeat for several. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market offer-cancel --order-ids <order_ids>
```
